hero.subtitle: Português: The governed command surface for enterprise AI. Unify software, AI agents, and enterprise platforms into one orchestrated layer where every action is authorized, logged, and reversible.

governance.label: Absolute Command
governance.description: Português: You issue the directive. OmniHub orchestrates every connected system with full real-time visibility. Actions logged. Agents tracked. Outcomes traceable.

naturalLanguage.title: Português: Natural language directives
naturalLanguage.desc: Issue commands in plain language. OmniHub translates intent into structured task plans across your agent network.

capabilityRouting.title: Português: Capability-matched routing
capabilityRouting.desc: Português: Each task routes to the most qualified agent. No guesswork, no misroutes, full audit of each routing decision.

override.title: Português: Override any agent, instantly
override.desc: One command halts, redirects, or replaces any running agent mid-execution. You remain in full control.

reversible.label: Português: Architectural Primitive
reversible.description: Português: The only enterprise AI platform where rollback is a first-class architectural primitive. One bad decision does not cascade. You undo it. Completely.

rollback.title: Português: One-click rollback
rollback.desc: Português: Reverse any agent action or workflow state with a single command. No cleanup required.

blastRadius.title: Português: Blast radius containment
blastRadius.desc: Português: OmniHub detects propagation risk and contains failures before they cascade across connected systems.

compensating.title: Português: Compensating transactions
compensating.desc: Each agent action carries a compensating operation. Distributed state stays coherent under rollback.

policyRules.name: Português: Scope Restriction
policyRules.desc: Português: No agent accesses unauthorized data scopes

policyRules.name: Português: Audit on Write
policyRules.desc: Português: Each write operation logged immutably
